 What We Do
 The Brain, the Heart,
the Engine, the Measure.
 Most projects start like this: „we need a campaign, a video, or something like that.” And then we start asking questions. Usually it turns out that’s not what’s needed at all.
 the Brain 
 Strategy & Brand Building
 Both creative and practical, dreamers and rationalists. Integrated marketing and PR strategy, employer branding, reputation management, media training — this is where answers emerge to questions you haven’t even thought to ask yet.
 PR strategy Employer branding Reputation Media training 
 the Heart 
 Content Production & Creative Execution
 When a brief finally becomes something — that people actually notice. TikTok videos, promotional films, animations, campaign copy, website texts, press releases, UX design, publications, offline creatives.
 Video production Copywriting Art direction Graphic design 
 the Engine 
 Digital Ecosystem & Growth
 The posts go out, the campaigns run, people respond. Social media management (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok), influencer marketing, newsletter automation, web development, CRO optimisation.
 Social media Influencer Newsletter Web development 
 the Measure 
 Performance & Data
 This is the part everyone loves to skip. We don’t. Media audit, campaign analysis, effectiveness measurement, PPC campaigns — Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok. Because this is where you find out if it worked.
 Media audit PPC Campaign analysis KPI measurement 
 Why us?
 The physics teacher
and the algorithm.
 In secondary school there was a physics teacher who only looked at the names on exam papers. Nagy Pisti always got top marks — Kállay Peti always got average. One day they swapped their names. Nothing changed in the physics. The grade did.
 AEO works the same way — only in reverse. Getting on the list is not enough. AI assistants surface the answer that genuinely responds to the question. Not the one that appears most often in the text.
 That is why we write answers, not keywords.
 Strategy, campaign planning, social media, graphic design, content production, press release writing — and yes, quantitative and qualitative research too, because most projects really should start with that, not with „we need something like this.”
 We help you figure out exactly what that something is.

 How We Work
 Four steps,
in every project.
 We don’t work from templates — we tailor a unique process for each client. But four steps are always there, in order.
 01
 Assessment
 We get to know the client, their market and their communication challenges. No generalisations — only the real situation.
 02
 Strategy Building
 A communication plan built on business objectives: with messages, channels, scheduling and measurable KPIs.

 Execution
